name: Insert
description: Inserts documents into a PostgreSQL pgvector table by generating embeddings from input content and storing both vectors and metadata. Similar to vector store nodes in n8n.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__Postgres
fields.label: PostgreSQL Credential
fields.description: Credentials for connecting to the PostgreSQL database that contains the pgvector extension enabled.

fields.name: tableName
fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: Name of the pgvector table where documents and embeddings will be stored.

fields.name: batch
fields.label: Batch Size
fields.description: Number of documents to process per batch when generating embeddings.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__Embedding
fields.label: Embedding Model
fields.description: Model used to convert document content into vector embeddings.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__Document
fields.label: Document Loader Config
fields.description: Configuration for loading or generating documents before embedding (e.g., text loader, file loader, API source). Works similar to embedding config.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the insertion status including number of processed documents and any errors.
